display_long_description:
You wake with a pounding headache, surrounded by unfamiliar walls. You cannot remember how you arrived—or why the house feels strangely familiar.

The Forgotten House is a first-person psychological mystery built around exploration, puzzles, and fragmented memories. Search the house for clues, uncover hidden objects, and piece together the life you have forgotten.

At the heart of the mystery is Morphis, an invention capable of accessing memories. Through it, moments from your past begin to return. So do voices claiming to know what happened to you.

Their instructions may lead you forward. Their stories may contradict what you discover. Pay attention to the details: a familiar object, a hidden message, or a remembered conversation could change your understanding of everything.

• Explore a house filled with secrets
Search its rooms and basement for clues that connect the present to your forgotten past.

• Solve connected puzzles
Find codes, examine objects, and use what you learn to uncover hidden places.

• Recover fragments of your life
Experience memories that gradually reveal the people, relationships, and events behind your disappearance.

• Decide whom to believe
Listen carefully to the voices coming through Morphis. Help and manipulation can sound very much alike.

The house holds your memories. Finding them is only the beginning.
